digest.component_or_area: code-review framework — multi-pass criterion routing and evaluation
propositions: Project-declared code-review criteria were dropped at five integration points: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration surface, and CLI admission
The four-pass code-review system must thread project criteria through all five seams without losing logical attribution or repository-effective routing configuration

Repository-overlay project criteria must be discovered, resolved, routed to Pass-3 based on repository config, and admitted to eval/calibration and CLI workflows with the same contract as packaged criteria
The runtime contract for project code-review criteria must be documented and validated via end-to-end unit tests and live Gerrit dogfood with advisory-only review posture
Child tickets own disjoint production files across the five drop-point categories, sharing only the integration test suite to prove stack coverage
